annotations.title: Get consumption for a date window

description:
Get consumption for a date window

Sums the metered consumption recorded for this account over a date window, broken down into voice minutes and chat sessions. With no query parameters the window runs from midnight on the first day of the current month in server local time up to the moment of the request, which makes the bare call a current-month total. Both bounds are inclusive. The two counters are returned as 0 when nothing was metered in the window rather than being omitted, and the echoed `period` tells you exactly which window was measured. This reports usage only; for what is left to spend, call GET /users/me/limits.

from.description: Start of the window, inclusive. Defaults to the first day of the current month. Parsed as a date; an unparseable value yields an empty result rather than an error.

to.description: End of the window, inclusive. Defaults to the current server time.

name: get_my_usage
title: Get consumption for a date window
